content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**What changed in response to the verifier:** the Customer-favourable routing sentence in Article XXIV(c) ("For purposes of this Agreement, any Change of Control (as defined in Section 13.4(a)) shall be governed by the provisions of the section entitled Change Of Control and not the provisions of this Section") is now retained verbatim — no element required its deletion, and it usefully keeps a broader Change of Control (e.g. a >50% stock transfer) outside the retained assignment-consent prohibition. The Licensor-assignment restriction that previously overwrote it is now a short standalone insertion after Article XXIV(c).

**Final three operations (preferred level):**
1. **p0149 replace** — adds the consent-free carve-out for assignment to an Affiliate or an M&A successor, keeping all other words of both sentences verbatim (elements 1–2).
2. **Insert after p0149** — "Licensor may not assign this Agreement without Licensee's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and may not assign to a competitor of Licensee." (elements 3–5).
3. **p0134 replace** — Article XX(a) now states a Change of Control neither terminates the Agreement/licences nor gives Licensor a termination right; the "CHANGE OF CONTROL" definition lead-in, its (i)–(iii) limbs and Article XX(b) survive (element 6).

Nothing else in Articles XX or XXIV is disturbed, and the Article XXII right of first refusal is left to the ROFR/MFN rule.
